name: DeepPaperNote

description.en: DeepPaperNote is an agent skill for deep-reading a single paper and generating high-quality Obsidian-style research notes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
description.zh: 用于深度阅读单篇论文并生成高质量研究笔记的代理技能。

install: git clone https://github.com/917Dhj/DeepPaperNote（按 README 导入 Gemini CLI）

ecosystems.install: git clone https://github.com/917Dhj/DeepPaperNote（按 README 导入 Gemini CLI）

usecases.zh: 深度阅读论文并生成Obsidian风格的研究笔记
usecases.en: Deep-read papers and generate Obsidian-style research notes

author: 917Dhj
